product_overview: Public-facing website for Sagara IT Solutions that showcases services, portfolio, careers and enables visitors to request consultations, interact with an AI assistant, subscribe to a newsletter, and switch between English and Indonesian content.
core_goals: Allow prospective clients to learn about Sagara's services and view past work
Enable visitors to request a custom IT consultation and receive an immediate follow-up path
Provide instant, conversational assistance through an on-site AI chatbot
Capture marketing contacts via a newsletter subscription
Let visitors switch site language between English and Indonesian and persist that choice
Present open roles and recruitment information for prospective applicants

features.name: Browse Public Pages
features.description: Explore the company, services, portfolio, blog and general information without signing in.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Read hero messaging and high-level value proposition
Navigate to /about.html -> Read company overview and impact
Navigate to /services.html -> Browse service categories and short descriptions
Navigate to /portfolio.html -> Scan project highlights and case summaries
Navigate to /blog.html -> Read industry insights and news

features.name: Consultation Request
features.description: Submit a lead request for a custom IT roadmap and receive an immediate follow-up path (site opens a pre-filled Gmail compose to continue contact).
user_flows: Navigate to /contact.html -> Fill in full name -> Fill in email address (use a @gmail.com address) -> Select service type -> Enter project details -> Submit consultation request -> See Gmail compose window pre-filled for follow-up

Navigate to /contact.html -> Fill in full name -> Fill in email address (non-@gmail.com) -> Select service type -> Enter project details -> Attempt to submit -> See client-side validation error indicating only @gmail.com addresses are accepted

features.name: Sagara AI Chatbot
features.description: Instant on-site conversational assistant for quick questions, suggestions, and guided interactions.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open AI chatbot -> Type a question or request -> Send the message -> See chatbot response in the chat panel (reply to the query)

features.name: Newsletter Subscription
features.description: Join the company newsletter to receive updates and insights.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter newsletter email address -> Submit subscription -> See confirmation message acknowledging subscription

features.name: Language Switching
features.description: Switch the site copy between English and Indonesian with the choice persisted across pages.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Switch language to Indonesian -> Observe page content update to Indonesian
Navigate to /contact.html -> Observe language selection persisted and content shown in Indonesian -> Switch language to English -> Observe page content update to English

features.name: View Portfolio & Case Studies
features.description: Browse showcased projects and read concise case summaries to evaluate past outcomes and capabilities.
user_flows: Navigate to /portfolio.html -> Scan featured projects -> Read project summary and outcomes -> Use listed contact or consultation flow if interested

features.name: Careers & Job Listings
features.description: Discover open roles and recruitment information to evaluate opportunities at Sagara.
user_flows: Navigate to /careers.html -> Browse job listings and team culture information -> Read application instructions and next steps
